title: Local Lens
summary: Small models. Real questions. Results you can inspect.

cover.alt: Illustrative Local Lens interface for this fictional project

screenshots.alt: Detail of the fictional Local Lens workspace, labeled as a design preview

story.problem: A single benchmark number hides the examples that a small model handles well or poorly.
story.built: An evaluation desk for comparing local models on a compact set of practical tasks.
story.aiUse: Local models answer the same prompts. A simple viewer keeps outputs beside the evaluation criteria.
story.humanDecisions: I wrote the task set, recorded repeat runs, and inspected failures instead of relying only on a total score.
story.limitations: This illustrative evaluation is small. Its results would not establish general model quality.
